limitations: Item values are catalog prices, not champion power; Viego and failed audits are excluded from completion batches.
Purchase batches reflect net terminal non-boot item-count increases; undo inside each batch is included. Not all power spikes or recalls.
Kill segments start at their first kill, not fight initiation. Personal participation uses killer/victim/assist records.
Cash is the last strictly earlier minute frame, at most 65 seconds old; purchases and gains may intervene.
Counters around enemy acquisitions do not identify deliberate concessions or equal-value trades. Each own asset is assigned once.
No nearby kill is not proof of no contest or no nearby players.
Successive-game shifts are retrospective; draft, side, waves and opponent response remain. They do not identify learning.
State matching includes time, gold, past model WP and a draft-proxy caliper, not full composition control or side control when sides change.
